headline: Stable positive sentiment (score: +7.7)
key_insights: Fears trending up 54% over 7 days (strong momentum)
sentiment_commentary:
• Optimism leads today despite a negative score (-22.3), buoyed by 23 strong-intensity quotes out of 51 total — without those boosts, sentiment would look even weaker.
• All three categories are sitting in the lower half of their 257-day ranges, signalling a generally quiet and cautious day overall.
• Frustrations saw the sharpest shift, dropping from +18.6 yesterday to -12.8 today despite having the most quotes (74) and the highest share of strong-intensity responses (40), suggesting the volume is there but the upvote engagement has cooled significantly.
methodology: See METHODOLOGY.md. Scores use z-score normalization with empirically-derived intensity weights from analytics_config.yaml. Alerts at |z| >= threshold (configurable, default 2.0 for p < 0.05).
